title: Local Complete-Graph Optimality at Fitness Two and Strong-Selection Rigidity under Death–Birth Updating
demonstrated_defect: False index-shift identity in supporting Eq. (35) is explicitly used to justify the symmetric-sector scalar debt comparison underlying PDF A.31/A.32/A.36. The main weaker inequality remains unrefuted, but its supplied all-order derivation is incomplete.
affected_claims: All-order symmetric-balanced sector positivity in Theorem 9, in the phase range N>=40 (n>=41).
Consequently the all-n full-directed strict local optimality statement in Theorem 1 is not cleared by this proof.

exact_defect.main_pdf_location: Page 25, (A.31) debt inequality and (A.32) ratio; page 26 (A.36) conclusion.
exact_defect.verifier_gap: The exact checker defines the printed beta at lines 198–207 and checks margins at lines 277–287, but does not check Eq. (35) or independently establish the all-order actual-debt comparison.
exact_defect.nonrefutation_control: The actual debt remains <= the printed sum in exact probes N=3,4,10,24,40,80,288. Thus this review does not claim A.31 or the main theorem false.

strongest_supported_claim: For fixed complete-support positive directed loopless weights, the strong-selection deficit is E_dir/[n^2(n-2)r]+O(r^-2), with zero coefficient exactly for incoming-column-uniform weights inducing J_n. Together with the correctly scoped noncomplete-support theorem and the source-component bound, every other fixed finite kernel is eventually strictly suppressing. Independently computed fitness-two curvatures at n=3..6 are strictly negative in the tested nonzero directions and match all printed eigenvalues.
exact_remaining_gap: An all-order justification for the symmetric-sector scalar debt bound required by A.31/A.36 is missing from the supplied derivation because the stated Eq. (35) equality is false. A new argument or repair and fresh review would be needed; no such repair is supplied here.
